name: Transporter Vehicles
query:
SELECT
	tv.parent as "Transporter:Link/Transporter:150",
	tv.vehicle_number as "Vehicle Number:Data:140",
	tv.vehicle_type as "Vehicle Type:Data:120",
	tv.mode as "Mode:Data:120",
	tv.capacity_tonnes as "Capacity (T):Float:100",
	tv.transit_days as "Transit Days:Int:100",
	tv.standard_rate_basis as "Standard Rate:Currency:120",
	tv.owner_name as "Owner:Data:140",
	tv.driver_name as "Driver:Data:140",
	tv.driver_mobile as "Driver Mobile:Data:120"
FROM `tabTransporter Vehicle` tv
WHERE tv.parenttype = 'Transporter'
ORDER BY tv.parent, tv.vehicle_number
